messages:
anya (People Ops): FYI we're prepping for a client-led audit that needs verifiable training records and signed acknowledgements for the last 24 months. Audit window: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-14. Need to confirm retention policy and an export plan.

ella (Legal): Important: auditors will ask for chain-of-custody on attestations. We need a tamper-evident export and a clear retention statement in the handbook (2 years default; exceptions by legal).

ben (Security): From secops side: we must include timestamped attestations and the user agent/IP for each ack if possible. Also want the export hashed and S3 path with ACLs.

marta (Compliance): We track completion now but not signed attestations historically for some contractors. We'll need a way to surface missing signed docs and run an outreach. Suggest scoped ask: 24-month attestations for regulated-data folks first, then org-wide if time permits.

anya (People Ops): Agreed. Plan: (1) carve out reg_data_flag true users and produce an export with user_id, name, email, ack_ts, training_id, score, source, and attestation_signed_ts; (2) Legal + Sec verify export hash; (3) hand to auditor. Deadline for export: 2026-08-20.

nisha (HRIS): I can produce that export but need the attestation_signed_ts field to be populated from the ack system. If historical signed acks aren't available, I can mark null and we do outreach. ops-bot can drop file to secure S3 path.

ops-bot: Export scheduled: /internal/hr/audit_exports/attestations_2026-08-20.csv next run 2026-08-20T02:00Z :robot_face:

darren (Finance): Audit will likely ask for proof of training cost allocation too. Can we include training_session_id and cost_center? I need that to reconcile billed training time for SOX purposes.

anya (People Ops): Good point. Add cost_center and training_duration_mins to the export. Also we'll capture manager_id for escalation.

ella (Legal): I'll draft a short handbook blurb clarifying retention periods and that auditors may request attestations. We need approval from Compliance before publishing.

marta (Compliance): Approving in principle. One ask: create an exceptions CSV for vendor-managed contractors with contract_id and vendor_ack_proof. We'll accept vendor attestations in lieu of direct signed acks.

ben (Security): After export, I'll compute a SHA256 hash and store the hash in the secure logs. Please provide S3 path so I can verify ACLs.

nisha (HRIS): Ops-bot, please include these columns: user_id, name, email, manager_id, reg_data_flag, training_id, training_title, ack_ts, attestation_signed_ts, score, training_duration_mins, cost_center, source, contract_id, vendor_ack_proof.

ops-bot: Confirmed. Export template created at /internal/hr/templates/attestation_export_template.csv :robot_face:

anya (People Ops): Outreach plan: we'll email people with missing signed acks the week of 2026-08-01, CC managers. If contractors/vendors are missing, reach out to vendor contacts and legal will escalate.

darren (Finance): Also note: if we bill any training stipends to contractors, include stipend_amount and payment_status in the report.

nisha (HRIS): Will add stipend_amount and payment_status columns.

ella (Legal): Draft wording for handbook update: "Redwood retains mandatory training attestations for two years from the attestation date. For regulated roles, attestations may be retained longer as required by law or customer contract." I'll post the exact PR in the handbook repo.

anya (People Ops): Manager comms template to copy into team channels?

marta (Compliance): Template: "Heads-up: Redwood will run a mandatory attestation check for regulated-data roles. If you see a missing signed attestation, please complete it within 10 business days or notify your manager for exception."

ops-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by ops-bot

ben (Security): Action items summary: 1) HRIS export template ready (nisha) 2) ops-bot schedule export (ops-bot) 3) Sec compute hash + verify ACLs after export (ben) 4) Legal handbook PR + approve wording (ella) 5) Compliance outreach list and vendor exception handling (marta) 6) Finance columns added (darren).

anya (People Ops): I'll coordinate and post a status update on 2026-07-25. If anyone needs a sample CSV to test ingestion to their systems, DM me and I'll provide one."
